description: Load a URL in the active page. Returns page representation after navigation. Default minimal detail includes landmarks, headings, and interactive element counts — use charlotte_find to locate specific elements, or pass detail: 'summary' to get the full element list.

wait_for.description: Wait condition: "load" (default), "domcontentloaded", "networkidle". Note: "networkidle" is unreliable on SPAs with persistent WebSocket connections.

name: charlotte_navigate
